scoring_justification: The raw DFT output files are not part of the output contract; the agent compiles energies and moments into a scored JSON. The checker compares these reported numbers to paper‑reported gold with tolerances (±50 meV for ΔE, ±0.2 μB for moment) and verifies structural properties (all ΔE negative, correct ground state ID, vacancy trend).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for ΔE (meV) and magnetic moments (μB) for 2×2×4 configurations and vacancy effects, ground state id, and expected trends.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (2×2×4 rows) and Section 3.3 text; values extracted exactly: -326, -196, -225, -303, -193, -227; moments 3.08, 3.02, 2.88, 2.90, 3.03, 2.82; ground state (0,3); V_O ΔE -17, V_Sn ΔE -304.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published paper. No transformation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper‑reported values; they are used as reference targets with tolerances to accommodate implementation differences between codes/functionals.

configurations.description: List of results for each Zn configuration

total_moment_muB.description: Total magnetic moment of the supercell in μB

ground_state.description: The id of the configuration with the lowest FM total energy

V_O_delta_E_meV.description: FM-AFM energy difference with one oxygen vacancy, in meV

V_Sn_delta_E_meV.description: FM-AFM energy difference with one tin vacancy, in meV

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the computed FM-AFM energy differences, total magnetic moments, ground-state identification, and vacancy effects. The hidden checker compares reported values to paper references (±50 meV tolerance for ΔE, ±0.2 μB for moments), verifies all ΔE values are negative, checks that the ground-state id matches (0,3) and that V_Sn ΔE is more negative than the ground-state ΔE while V_O ΔE is less negative.

output_contract.notes: The checker will also verify structural properties (all ΔE negative, correct ground state ID, expected vacancy effect ordering). The numeric comparisons use tolerances that account for typical DFT code/functional variations.

steps.description: Check all six configuration delta_E_meV values are negative and within ±50 meV of paper values; ground_state ID must correspond to the configuration with lowest FM total energy.
Check total magnetic moment of the ground‑state configuration within ±0.2 μB of paper's 2.88 μB.
Check V_O_delta_E_meV and V_Sn_delta_E_meV are within ±50 meV of paper values (-17, -304).
Verify V_Sn ΔE is more negative than ground state ΔE, and V_O ΔE is less negative.
